name: Infidel
overview: The term 'infidel' relates to those who reject or do not believe in the truth of God as revealed in Scripture. The Bible contrasts God's unchanging truth and inability to lie with the deceitfulness of man, underscoring the seriousness of unbelief and falsehood. Those who persist in unbelief, immorality, and lying are warned of judgment and eternal separation from God, as seen in the condemnation of the fearful, unbelieving, and all liars in Revelation. This highlights the necessity of fleeing to the hope set before us through Christ, who is the foundation of our assurance.
